name: Jev YouTube
description: Voice control for YouTube: 'Jev, play X on YouTube'. Resolves the exact video with the free YouTube Data API when a key is configured, otherwise opens YouTube search. Playback control via system media keys.
capabilities: open exact video via free Data API quota
limits: without YOUTUBE_API_KEY opens search results instead of the exact video
media keys are Windows-only and need DESKTOP_INPUT_ENABLED=true
